fields.source_first_note: Read every word of this long original, including all appended transmissions. Main Jabir camel account supplies fatigue, striking/prayer, faster movement, one-uqiya sale after refusal, home-riding exception, arrival/payment, actual return attendance and gift with price not taken back. Retain the expedition circumstance, Medina arrival, I-attended predicate and explicit no-price-return clause. Distinguish each actually supplied riding-condition variant: Shuba route’s permission; Ishaq/Jarir route’s expressly parenthetic Jabir sale-condition; Ata’s explicitly reported instruction; Ibn al-Munkadir’s condition statement; Zaid’s instructed possession to Medina; Abu al-Zubayr’s permission; Amas’s ride-home instruction. Also retain actual one-uqiya purchase, four-dinar quotation, attributed one-uqiya-gold and two-hundred-dirham price details, Tabuk-return purchase with four-uqiya uncertainty, and Abu Nadra’s twenty-dinar purchase variant. All describe versions of this same source family, not separate independently verified sales. Keep pure multistep routes, corroboration-only clause, no-price omission comparison, currency-conversion explanation and final compiler majority/correctness appraisal as context. Preserve Hindi Ibn Jurair versus Urdu Ibn Jurayj literally; the unnamed first-person I-think-he-said uncertainty must visibly qualify its amount, without assigning its voice to an inferred narrator. Retain every supplied speech attribution parenthesis, return-from-expedition circumstance and bought predicate where substantive. Do not harmonize conflicting prices or silently prefer the compiler’s favored one.

Entire Urdu field independently read through the final Abu Abdullah appraisal. The actual main sale/ride/payment/gift account retains its expedition setting, Medina location, return appearance and no-price-repayment negative. The seven supplied riding/condition formulations are finite transmitted variants with their own printed Jabir or Prophet attribution bridges, and the several actual purchase/price details remain distinct qualified components in the same report family. In particular preserve the explicitly parenthetic Jabir-said and Messenger-said words rather than discard them as generic parentheses. The four-dinar exchange-rate calculation is compiler explanation; corroboration-only and missing-price observations are apparatus. Amas one-uqiya-gold and Abu Ishaq two-hundred-dirham clauses are affirmative attributed version details, without pretending they are direct Prophet quotes. Dawud-route Tabuk-return purchase, unnamed I-think four-uqiya uncertainty and Abu Nadra twenty-dinar purchase are actual supplied claims, not harmonized identities. Keep the final Shabi-majority/condition/correctness appraisal in full source context, with no authenticity endorsement. All original spellings and inconsistent quantities stay literal.

Read the complete Abu Hurayra account of the Ansar offer, negative Prophet answer, later work-for-fruit-share proposal and Muhajirun acceptance. Retain the after-brotherhood circumstance as actual temporal/social setting; the parenthetic Muhajirin label repeats the recipients explicitly named again in the resumed dialogue and can remain identity context. Keep all actual parties, the work condition, sharing consequence and affirmative commitment. Pure prefatory route is context.

Own full reading includes the Ansar proposed orchard division after muakhat, the refusal, their subsequent work/share offer to the Muhajirun and the latter’s actual acceptance. Keep the after-muakhat setting and every substantive condition/voice. The parenthetic مہاجرین apposition is repeated by the later explicit recipient name and can be context; the named later dialogue remains. Initial multistep chain alone is omitted from reader text.

Read the full source route and actual Abdullah report that the Messenger gave Khaybar land to the Jews on working/sowing and half-produce terms. The field calls the reporter only Abdullah, so do not expand to an unprinted patronymic from Nafi or familiar wording. Keep both duties and exact half-yield consequence; preserve the source typo दी जया करेगी.

Entire own Urdu field supplies Abdullah’s report of the Khaybar land arrangement, actual Jewish recipients, work/sowing condition and half-produce share. Keep all substantive scope and the printed grammar. Do not identify Abdullah beyond the source’s own name; the earlier Musa/Juwayriyah/Nafi prefatory route stays context.
